biocs.name: Process connecting to rare cloud resource
biocs.description: Detects a process connecting to an IP address that is not commonly seen in the environment
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_process_image_name != 'System'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'System'
| comp count() as events by actor_process_image_name, agent_hostname
| sort desc events
